notes: Forward-compatible schema 109 to 112 bridge. Migrations through 109 are immutable applied production history. Migration 110 makes ecommerce order creation and its durable notification intent atomic. Migration 111 adds multi-category product associations while preserving the primary category_id compatibility field. Migration 112 allows products and their owned variants to be deleted atomically while order, inventory, and loyalty history continues to restrict deletion. A verified schema-109 backup is required before migration; recovery is forward-repair-only after schema advances beyond 109.
